export const meta = {
  name: 'slow-probe',
  description: 'Two slow agents, then a tail',
  phases: [{ title: 'Wait' }, { title: 'Tail' }],
}
const P = 'Use the Bash tool to run exactly: sleep 90 (foreground, run_in_background false, timeout 120000). Then reply with only: done'
phase('Wait')
log('waiting on two sleepers')
await parallel([1, 2].map(i => () => agent(P, { label: `wait-${i}`, phase: 'Wait', model: 'haiku' })))
phase('Tail')
await agent('Reply with only: ok', { label: 'tail', phase: 'Tail', model: 'haiku' })
